Q1: ARE THERE ORDER EFFECTS?

range(d$Repetition)
## [1] 1 6
d.fil <- d %>% 
  filter(Repetition <= 3)
ggplot(d.fil, aes(Repetition, ReactionTime)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") +
  facet_grid(Task ~ Experiment) +
  theme_minimal()

agr <- d.fil %>% 
  group_by(Experiment,Task,ID.true,Repetition) %>% 
  summarise(
    MeanLogRT = mean(log(ReactionTime), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(agr, aes(x = Repetition, y = MeanLogRT, group = ID.true)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  facet_grid(Task ~ Experiment) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Trial number", y = "Mean Log reaction time")

ggplot(agr, aes(x = Repetition, y = MeanLogRT)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 1.5) +
  facet_grid(Task ~ Experiment) +
  theme_minimal()

d.fil %>%
  group_by(Experiment, Task, ID.true, Repetition) %>%
  summarise(MeanLogRT = mean(log(ReactionTime), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Repetition, y = MeanLogRT, group = ID.true)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  facet_grid(Task ~ Experiment) +
  theme_minimal()

Does Repetition explain RT more than Task?

names(d.fil)
##  [1] "...1"            "ID.true"         "Word"            "Label"          
##  [5] "ConcValCombo"    "Task"            "BlockOrder"      "Group"          
##  [9] "Response"        "Accuracy"        "EventTime"       "Value"          
## [13] "RT"              "ReactionTime"    "Key_value_F"     "Key_value_J"    
## [17] "Comments"        "LogReactionTime" "LogRT"           "TrialNumber"    
## [21] "Category"        "Experiment"      "Conceptual"      "Animacy"        
## [25] "Valence"         "Repetition"
d.fil$Task <- factor(d.fil$Task)
d.fil$Experiment <- factor(d.fil$Experiment)
d.fil$Repetition <- factor(d.fil$Repetition)

m1 <- lmer(
  log(ReactionTime) ~ Task * Experiment +
    (1 | ID.true) +
    (1 + Task | Word),
  data = d.fil
)
## Warning in checkConv(attr(opt, "derivs"), opt$par, ctrl = control$checkConv, :
## Model failed to converge with max|grad| = 0.00316298 (tol = 0.002, component 1)
m2 <- lmer(
  log(ReactionTime) ~ Task * Experiment * Repetition +
    (1 | ID.true) +
    (1 + Repetition + Task | Word),
  data = d.fil
)
## boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
## Warning: Model failed to converge with 1 negative eigenvalue: -1.9e+02
anova(m1, m2)
## refitting model(s) with ML (instead of REML)
## Data: d.fil
## Models:
## m1: log(ReactionTime) ~ Task * Experiment + (1 | ID.true) + (1 + Task | Word)
## m2: log(ReactionTime) ~ Task * Experiment * Repetition + (1 | ID.true) + (1 + Repetition + Task | Word)
##    npar   AIC   BIC logLik deviance  Chisq Df Pr(>Chisq)    
## m1   19 60411 60584 -30187    60373                         
## m2   54 58143 58633 -29017    58035 2338.8 35  < 2.2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
